title: Santa Ana on I-5: Exits, Gas, Food & Stops | I-5 Buddy
meta: Santa Ana sits at exit 105 on I-5. See nearby exits, mapped gas, EV, food and lodging, the Santa Ana Zoo, and the nearest rest areas.
intro: Santa Ana is the county seat, at exit 105 on I-5, on land once part of Rancho Santiago de Santa Ana, granted in 1810 to José Antonio Yorba. This page lists the nearby exits from Red Hill Avenue to Chapman Avenue, with the gas, EV charging, food and lodging mapped at each. Services come from OpenStreetMap as mapped, not live.

faq.q: What exit is Santa Ana on I-5?
faq.a: Santa Ana, the county seat, is at exit 105 on I-5. Exit 105A is 17th Street and exit 105B is Main Street and Broadway.

faq.q: Where can I get gas near Santa Ana on I-5?
faq.a: Gas is mapped at several exits nearby. Exit 101B lists Arco, Chevron, Mobil, Shell and Valero, exit 103A lists Arco, SC Fuels, Shell and Speeed Gas, and exit 107B lists 7-Eleven and Ralphs.

faq.q: Where are EV chargers near Santa Ana on I-5?
faq.a: Mapped chargers include a Tesla Supercharger at exits 101B, 104B, 105A and 106, EVgo at exit 104, and ChargePoint and Rove at exit 105A. Exit 107B also lists an EV charger.

faq.q: Is there a zoo near I-5 in Santa Ana?
faq.a: Yes. The Santa Ana Zoo is right beside the freeway in Prentice Park, near exit 104, and it opened on March 8, 1952.

faq.q: Where is the nearest rest area to Santa Ana on I-5?
faq.a: The nearest listed rest area south is Aliso Creek Rest Area at mile 59.4, 45.6 miles away. North is Tejon Pass Rest Area at mile 206.1, 101.1 miles away, and both serve both directions.
